evidence: objdump of terranx_original.exe at 0x00644F3A: mov eax,[esp+4]; test eax,eax; jge +2; neg eax; ret — the 9-byte abs(int). At 0x00644EF2: push esi; mov esi,[esp+8]; test esi,esi; je ... with heap-block validation (push 9; calls into 0x647d04/0x647df4/0x647e1f) and HeapFree through IAT slot 0x669198 — the retail free(void*).

Cross-check inside decode_fli_copy (0x0062AB80-0x0062ACB6): the span's calls are 0x005D4510 (mem_get), 0x005E33F3 (Buffer::get_data HHH), 0x00646178 (fread) in its row loop, and one call to 0x00644EF2 at 0x62ACAA as the last call before the epilogue — where the body's single trailing heap operation is free(scratch); its ORIGINAL marker lists 0x00644EF2 without 0x00644F3A, and neither the seed nor the product body computes an abs there.

Under this mapping every checked Flic function's emitted references reconcile with its ORIGINAL call list: decode_byte_run, decode_delta_flc and decode_byte_run_trans emit both _abs and _free (both addresses listed); decode_chunk emits _abs only for the trailing position correction abs(end - ftell(file_)) (only 0x00644F3A listed; image: lea ebp,[eax+ebx-6] ... sub ebp,eax; call 0x00644F3A at 0x62AEC2); decode_delta_flc_trans emits _abs with no _free and no mem_get, matching its four-entry list; decode_fli_copy emits _free only, matching its four-entry list. Current src/flic.cpp spellings already emit exactly these sets.
payload.hypothesis: The two uncatalogued CRT addresses in the Flic family's ORIGINAL call lists are free = 0x00644EF2 and abs(int) = 0x00644F3A; pinning these identities reconciles every checked function's emitted reference set with its ORIGINAL call list, and explains why the strict reference comparator cannot resolve them (isolated TU compiles leave _free/_abs unbound, producing unknown rather than fail — the same terminal state as the _fread/_fseek/_fclose/EH obligations).
